package services

import (
 \"testing\"
 \"github.com/gravitational/trace\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestApplyValueTraitsRejectsNestedUnsupportedInternalTrait(t *testing.T) {
 _, err := ApplyValueTraits("'`{{regexp.replace(internal.secret, "''^a$", "b")}}`, map[string][]string{"secret": {"a"}})

}
EOF
